description: Add a description field to deployment models to allow users to provide additional context about their deployments. This field should be optional and support storing text-based descriptions that can help teams document deployment purposes, changes, or notes.
functional_requirements: Add an optional 'description' field to the deployment model/struct in the backend
Include the description field in the deployment type definition for TypeScript frontend compatibility
Ensure the description field can store text content and is nullable/optional
Update any relevant serialization/deserialization logic to handle the new field
